title: Computing the ACWR on a daily calendar
text: day t, w daily load: RAC (coupled): acute = sum w days t-6 t; chronic = sum days t-27 t, divided 4. RAU (uncoupled): acute load; chronic = sum days t-27 t-7, divided 3. EWMA: Et = wt λ + (1 - λ) Et-1, λ = 2 / (N + 1), N = 7 (acute) 28 (chronic), updated every calendar day including rest days (Williams et al., 2017). RAC RAU acute chronic loads weekly-equivalent sums, read “load per week”. ACWR() computes three every athlete returns one row per session, original order: Athlete 3, doubled number sessions last week, shows highest ratios.

title: Acute Chronic Workload Ratio Calculation
text: ACWR package designed calculate acute chronic workload ratio using three different methods: exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA), rolling average coupled (RAC) rolling average uncoupled (RAU). Sessions placed daily calendar: sessions day summed days without session count load 0. Acute chronic loads computed calendar days, sessions: Acute load: sum daily load last 7 days. RAC chronic load: sum last 28 days / 4 (coupled). RAU chronic load: sum days 8 28 today / 3 (uncoupled). EWMA: exponentially weighted moving averages time-decay constants 7 28 days, updated every calendar day (Williams et al., 2017). Version 0.2.0 fixed bug: results earlier versions correct exactly one session every day. See NEWS.md.

text: Sessions first turned daily series first last date: sessions day summed days without session count load 0. , every calendar day \(t\) daily load \(w_t\): $$E_t = w_t \lambda + (1 - \lambda) E_{t-1}, \quad \lambda = 2 / (N + 1)$$ \(N = 7\) (acute) \(N = 28\) (chronic), \(E_1 = w_1\). Acute chronic loads scale daily load. session gets value day. Values rounded. EWMA recursive: missing load (NA) makes day every later day NA. warning given; impute missing loads calling function.

title: ACWR 0.2.0
text: 0.1.0, RAC() RAU() averaged load per session inside window, EWMA() decayed per session, ignoring dates. Rest days therefore counted zero load, results correct exactly one session every day. RAC() RAU() also failed “NA/NaN argument” week number missing. 0.2.0, athlete’s sessions turned daily series first last date: sessions day summed days without session count load 0. exactly one session every day, EWMA results unchanged RAC RAU ratios unchanged day 28 (except rounding), RAC/RAU acute chronic loads now 7 times larger (weekly sums instead daily averages) ratios NA first 27 days. Whenever sessions daily, results differ. example, weekly loads 3 sessions per week three weeks 6 fourth, coupled ratio (RAC) last session now 1.45 (0.93), uncoupled ratio (RAU) 1.70 (1.31) EWMA 1.20 (0.93).

title: ACWR 0.2.0
text: acute: sum daily load last 7 days (including today); RAC chronic: sum last 28 days / 4 (coupled); RAU chronic: sum days 8 28 today / 3 (uncoupled). follows definitions coupled uncoupled ratios Windt & Gabbett (2019) doi:10.1136/bjsports-2017-098925 (recent week divided average last 4 weeks, 3 preceding weeks). Summing calendar days counts rest days zero load. EWMA() applies decay every calendar day, including rest days zero load, Williams et al. (2017) doi:10.1136/bjsports-2016-096589. acute chronic loads scale daily load. RAC() RAU() return NA 28 days history exist (acute loads, 7 days). new argument partial = TRUE uses days available instead. ACWR() also gains partial. missing load (NA) makes every window containing day NA, one warning gives number affected days. EWMA recursive, every later day NA EWMA; impute missing loads calling functions. ratio NA chronic load 0. Values longer rounded inside functions.
